title: 第5章 血手屠夫第6章 徒手断刀杀
lines: 砂河镇的规模颇大，人口十万，街道纵横，房屋林立，行人如织，商业极为繁华。
许辰连夜赶路，肚子已经饿了。
最后。
他在一家名叫‘仙客’酒楼的门前停下了脚步。
店小二见状，连忙卑躬屈膝的迎了上来，“公子，打尖还是吃饭？”
“吃饭。”
说完，他大步走入酒楼。
酒楼共有三层。
第一层，大堂，摆放着十几张桌子，此时在一层大堂用餐的食客竟然有七八桌，都是武者。
第二层，拥有单独包间。
第三层，贵宾包厢，需要有一定的身份，才能进入第三层的贵宾包厢。
“公子，一楼还是二楼？”
店小二笑着问道
“一楼吧。”
许辰径直走到拐角的一张桌子。
“公子，想要吃些什么？”
“上几个你们店里的拿手菜即可。”
许辰抽出椅子坐下，端起茶壶给自己倒了一杯，随口说道。
“你稍等。”
店小二满脸堆笑的离开了。
许辰喝了杯茶，看着隔壁桌付账离开的一行人，皱眉道：“自打我进入砂河镇后，已经看到十几波神色匆匆的武者了。
难不成，这砂河镇真有什么蹊跷？”
此时，一群人走了进来。
许辰抬头看去。
进来的一共七人。
五男两女。
七人进入酒楼后，并未停留，直接走向二楼。
七人的背影消失在楼梯口后，许辰隐约听到间隔几桌的食客在低声交谈。
“是流云宗的弟子。”
“没想到消息传的那么快，连流云宗的弟子都闻声赶来了。”
“不止流云宗，我听闻天剑山庄的弟子也来了。”
“这下子越来越有趣了。”
“水府出世，注定又是一场腥风血雨。”
“果然有事！”
content_en:
Shahe Town is quite large, with a population of 100,000, criss-crossing streets, numerous houses, numerous pedestrians, and extremely prosperous commerce.
Xu Chen traveled all night and was already hungry.
at last.
He stopped in front of a restaurant called "Xianke".
Seeing this, the waiter in the shop hurriedly came forward with humility, "Sir, do you want to shoot or eat?"
"Eat."
After saying that, he strode into the restaurant.
The restaurant has three floors.
There are more than a dozen tables in the lobby on the first floor. At this time, there are actually seven or eight tables of diners dining in the lobby on the first floor, all of them are warriors.
The second floor has separate private rooms.
The third floor is the VIP box. You need to have a certain identity to enter the VIP box on the third floor.
"Sir, first floor or second floor?"
The waiter asked with a smile
"On the first floor."
Xu Chen walked straight to a table in the corner.
"Sir, what do you want to eat?"
"Just serve a few of your store's specialty dishes."
Xu Chen took out his chair and sat down, picked up the teapot and poured himself a cup, and said casually.
"Just a moment."
The waiter left with a smile on his face.
Xu Chen drank a cup of tea, looked at the group of people at the next table paying the bill and leaving, and frowned: "Since I entered Shahe Town, I have seen more than a dozen waves of warriors looking in a hurry.
Is it possible that there is really something strange about this Shahe Town? "
At this time, a group of people walked in.
Xu Chen looked up.
A total of seven people came in.
Five men and two women.
After the seven people entered the restaurant, they did not stop and went directly to the second floor.
The seven figures disappeared behind the stairs, and Xu Chen vaguely heard the diners at a few tables talking in low voices.
"He is a disciple of Liuyun Sect."
"I didn't expect the news to spread so quickly. Even the disciples of Liuyun Sect heard the news and came over."
"Not only Liuyun Sect, I heard that disciples from Tianjian Villa are also here."
"It's getting more and more interesting now."
"When Shuifu is born, it is destined to be another bloody storm."
"..."
"Sure enough, something happened!"
